title: Yara and the Inheritance
author: Ulyana Zhou
blurb: Freya Brightwater, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
